name: conversations-tool-calls
description: /conversations previews an assistant turn's tool calls (issue #25): a saved session whose assistant turn called bash shows `[tool: bash] {...}` under its text instead of dropping the call. Seeds one session into an empty HOME, hub off, setup marked done so the first-run wizard stays out of the way.

setup.command: rm -rf /tmp/kollab-conv-tools && mkdir -p /tmp/kollab-conv-tools/.kollab && printf '%s' '{"plugins":{"hub":{"enabled":false}},"application":{"setup_completed":true}}' > /tmp/kollab-conv-tools/.kollab/config.json && d=/tmp/kollab-conv-tools/.kollab/projects/$(pwd | sed 's#^/##; s#/#_#g')/conversations && mkdir -p "$d" && printf '%s\n' '{"type":"conversation_metadata","startTime":"2026-10-10T00:00:00Z","cwd":"/work","gitBranch":"main"}' '{"type":"user","uuid":"u1","timestamp":"2026-10-10T00:00:01Z","message":{"role":"user","content":"list the files"}}' '{"type":"assistant","uuid":"a2","timestamp":"2026-10-10T00:00:02Z","message":{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Checking the directory."},{"type":"tool_use","id":"t1","name":"bash","input":{"command":"ls -la"}}]}}' '{"type":"user","uuid":"u3","timestamp":"2026-10-10T00:00:03Z","message":{"role":"user","content":"thanks"}}' > "$d/2610100000-spec-session.jsonl"
setup.description: seed one saved session whose assistant turn made a bash tool call

steps.description: its tool call shows under the text
